payout_quote: Refer them to Chevron Federal Credit Union and earn $25 for each one who joins! ... $25 will be credited to the current member's Savings account as a dividend once the referral successfully opens and funds their new membership.
steps: Be a Chevron Federal Credit Union member in good standing; complete the referral form for each person you refer.
You and the potential new member each receive an email with a referral code and instructions to use it during the membership application.
The referred person successfully opens AND funds their new membership.
You receive $25 credited to your Savings account as a dividend.
catches: The referral must not only join but also fund their new membership - a funded account is required before the $25 pays.
Limited to existing members in good standing; current Chevron FCU and Spectrum Credit Union employees are excluded.
Limited-time offer that can end at any time without notice.
A separate $50 promotion ran May 4-15, 2026 and has ended; the standard $25 rate now applies.
biggest_catch: The referred person must actually fund their new membership - an unfunded application earns nothing, and the offer can end anytime.
eligibility: Existing Chevron FCU members in good standing (employees of Chevron FCU and Spectrum CU excluded); referred persons must open and fund new membership.
timing: $25 credited to the current member's Savings account as a dividend once the referral successfully opens and funds their new membership.
